source_repository.scope: Committed V1 functional asset groups available in the dedicated V2 worktree. Newer uncommitted files observed in the source checkout are excluded.

classification_definitions.reuse_directly: Reuse the engineering primitive or immutable historical evidence without importing V1 universe, alpha, weight, qualification, or promotion state.
classification_definitions.reuse_after_contract_upgrade: Keep the implementation or data shape, but do not use it in V2 decisions until V2 identity, clock, source, PIT, authorization, mapping, schema, and failure contracts pass.
classification_definitions.migrate_as_zero_weight_challenger: Re-register the V1 decision mechanism as a new default-off V2 challenger with zero weight and fresh evidence.
classification_definitions.legacy_diagnostic_only: Retain for history, regression, opportunity-cost, or anti-repeat navigation; never use it to establish V2 eligibility or Gate results.
classification_definitions.retire: Preserve referenced historical bytes, but stop new V2 reads or writes through this path after its canonical replacement is verified.

startup_audit.interpretation: Historical audit gaps prevent treating V1 aggregate status as V2 evidence; canonical shards remain useful immutable history and anti-repeat evidence.

assets.name: Experiment identity tooling and canonical per-ID shards
assets.evidence: Reservation is atomic and tickets/logs are the canonical per-ID history; the V2 protocol explicitly ranks these shards above aggregate summaries.
assets.v2_action: Reuse IDs, immutable history, and anti-repeat evidence only; V1 outcomes and promotion labels confer no V2 status.

assets.name: Atomic file persistence and recovery primitives
assets.evidence: Same-directory temporary writes, fsync, bounded Windows rename retries, cleanup, and recovery tests are independent of V1 investment conclusions.
assets.v2_action: Reuse as low-level persistence plumbing; record schemas and append-only semantics remain V2-specific.

assets.name: Cash ledger, fill model, and conservation tests
assets.evidence: The implementation provides deterministic event ordering, explicit negative-cash accounting, conservation checks, and gap/slippage mechanics.
assets.v2_action: Reuse algorithms and tests while freezing new V2 cost and fill versions separately.

assets.name: Reservation-time experiment manifests and lifecycle enforcement
assets.evidence: Current manifests are reservation-time records and the startup audit reports historical promotion and result-ceiling violations.
assets.v2_action: Add final code, raw-input, artifact, V2 schema, PIT, and production-impact identities before V2 experiments use the lifecycle.

assets.name: Hash-bound append, locking, conflict, and idempotency patterns
assets.evidence: These writers contain useful hash, lock, conflict, full-panel, and idempotency patterns, but their record models are V1-specific.
assets.v2_action: Port the patterns into V2 EvidenceRecord, CandidatePool, UniverseEvent, and execution records; remove collection-clock wall-time fallbacks.

assets.name: US session calendar and price as-of guards
assets.evidence: Timezone-aware completed-session and fail-closed tests are useful, but special closures are incomplete and undated price maps can still be accepted.
assets.v2_action: Create one canonical effective session service, cover special sessions, require dated prices, and forbid process-wall-clock trade-date inference.

assets.name: Replay/daily parity contract and tests
assets.evidence: The shared-policy and replay/daily invariants are reusable, while the helper also embeds V1 entry, sizing, slot, add-on, and exit rules.
assets.v2_action: Retain parity assertions but remap them onto the V2 decision chain and Engine-0; migrate embedded V1 rules only through challenger registration.

assets.name: Massive OHLCV ingestion and source-contract evidence
assets.evidence: The pipeline records raw hashes, retrieval UTC, unadjusted data, secret hygiene, transactional normalization, and research-only authorization.
assets.v2_action: Add effective-dated security identity, vendor correction/vintage proof, durable entitlement evidence, and a canonical V2 SourceContract.

assets.name: Prospective official-source event observers
assets.evidence: First-seen and idempotent observer designs are useful, but first local observation does not prove first public availability and historical current snapshots are retrospective seeds.
assets.v2_action: Require observed_at, published_at, known_at, raw identity/hash, authorization, effective mappings, and explicit forward T0 before use.

assets.name: Vendor and broker data adapters
assets.evidence: Adapter code is reusable, but historical rows lack machine-bound entitlement, downstream-use authorization, raw evidence hashes, and reliable known_at clocks.
assets.v2_action: Bind entitlement and source contracts, use fetch time conservatively as known_at, version raw payloads, and fail closed on missing clocks.

assets.name: Price warehouse and estimate-revision data layer
assets.evidence: Versioning and quarantine logic exist, but authorization, adjustment/revision vintages, event identity, and current-time defaults are incomplete.
assets.v2_action: Freeze adjustment/vintage semantics, source authorization, security mapping, and decision clocks before V2 evidence use.

assets.name: Research digest consumption state and AI output validators
assets.evidence: Stable IDs, hashes, append-only dispositions, outcome-field rejection, and permission guards are reusable; digest entries remain derived navigation and lack complete source authorization.
assets.v2_action: Map accepted content into sourced V2 ResearchClaim and HypothesisCandidate records; generated candidates and recommendations do not carry forward.

assets.name: Paper sleeve runner and execution-contract shell
assets.evidence: The shell provides default-off paper execution and layout checks, but its records do not implement the complete V2 decision chain.
assets.v2_action: Upgrade the shell to V2 DecisionRecord, OrderIntent, Fill/Reject, PositionState, SettledOutcome, and ReplacementValue contracts before wiring challengers.

assets.name: V1 strategy and paper-sleeve mechanisms
assets.evidence: These modules encode V1 stock selection, entry, ranking, sizing, and exit hypotheses; historical results cannot establish V2 qualification.
assets.v2_action: Select migrations by mechanism coverage and contract readiness, then re-register each with fresh V2 evidence and an independent forward window.

assets.name: V1 allocator and portfolio policy mechanisms
assets.evidence: Allocator code embeds V1 source priority, capital, concentration, and opportunity-cost choices, including historical promotion state.
assets.v2_action: Rebuild only after Engine-0 and challenger evidence exist; start at zero weight and prove incremental portfolio value with fixed capital.

assets.name: V1 decision rules embedded in parity and backtest code
assets.evidence: The paths encode entry, slot, sizing, add-on, exit, and adapter-promotion behavior beyond generic parity infrastructure.
assets.v2_action: Extract only explicitly selected mechanisms into shared V2 policies; do not inherit parity-matrix status or Gate claims.

assets.name: V1 universe snapshots, memberships, and current-map discovery
assets.evidence: Membership generation can use current sector/security caches, source hashes can be null, and wall-clock defaults can assign dates; historical delisted coverage is incomplete.
assets.v2_action: Use only to diagnose V1 behavior; V2 M2 must generate an effective-dated append-only universe without seeding from these members.

assets.name: V1 backtester and cash-feasible baseline artifacts
assets.evidence: The V2 protocol permits V1 baselines only for regression and opportunity-cost comparison, not as the independent V2 Gate-1 anchor.
assets.v2_action: Retain frozen references for comparison; build Engine-0 on the V2 PIT universe and shared decision chain in M3.

assets.name: Candidate training, live-drift, and replacement-value derived ledgers
assets.evidence: These rows are useful diagnostics, but include plain append paths, malformed-row tolerance, or replacement values rebuilt from mutable current state.
assets.v2_action: Use for gap discovery only; do not import rows into V2 forward or settlement ledgers.

assets.name: V1 AI syntheses, free-text advice, replay, and trade gating
assets.evidence: Historical AI outputs can be outcome-aware, and the V1 advisor parses free text into pending actions that can alter approved trades, conflicting with the V2 AI boundary.
assets.v2_action: Retain for anti-repeat and regression analysis only; V2 AI output must terminate in sourced ResearchClaim or hypothesis records with no trading authority.

assets.name: V1 live-capable or unflagged sleeve paths
assets.evidence: Static inspection found live-capable boolean paths in the pilot/event helpers and three sleeves without an explicit trade-enabled flag.
assets.v2_action: Do not import or execute these paths in V2; require an explicit fail-closed wrapper, zero-weight challenger registration, and activation review before reconsideration.

assets.name: Aggregate registry and experiment dashboards
assets.evidence: These large aggregate products are rebuildable navigation views; canonical per-ID shards outrank them and the startup audit reports historical inconsistencies.
assets.v2_action: Use only to navigate toward canonical tickets, logs, manifests, and artifacts; never cite aggregates as V2 truth.

assets.name: Legacy mirrored tickets and direct aggregate-log append path
assets.evidence: The mirror overlaps canonical tickets and contains divergent copies; direct aggregate writes bypass the canonical per-ID shard model.
assets.v2_action: Stop new reads and writes after references are mapped; preserve historical bytes and use experiments/tickets plus experiment.py instead.

assets.name: Superseded strategy runner and executable legacy experiment paths
assets.evidence: These paths are superseded or intentionally segregated from current registered execution and can bypass newer experiment and contract routing.
assets.v2_action: Stop new V2 execution and references; preserve artifacts solely for provenance until archival mapping is complete.

assets.name: Duplicate market calendar and legacy automation loop
assets.evidence: Two independent market-session implementations invite clock drift, while the old loop predates V2 milestone, receipt, and default-off contracts.
assets.v2_action: Stop V2 use; migrate callers to the upgraded canonical session service and the V2 hourly launcher before archival cleanup.
